summary_script = '''import re

orders = []

for match in re.finditer(r"\\((\\d+),\\s*(\\d+)\\):\\s*([^\\t\\n]+)", raw):
    row, col, val = int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2)), match.group(3).strip()
    if row == 1:
        headers[col] = val
    else:
        if row not in [o.get("_row") for o in orders]:
            orders.append({"_row": row})
        for o in orders:
            if o["_row"] == row:
                o[headers.get(col, f"col{col}")] = val
                break

total_orders = len(orders)
confirmed = [o for o in orders if o.get("Status") == "confirmed"]
cancelled = [o for o in orders if o.get("Status") == "cancelled"]

# Revenue
total_revenue = sum(float(o.get("Total Paid", 0)) for o in orders)
confirmed_revenue = sum(float(o.get("Total Paid", 0)) for o in confirmed)
cancelled_revenue = sum(float(o.get("Total Paid", 0)) for o in cancelled)
avg_order = total_revenue / total_orders if total_orders else 0

# Customers
cust_spend = defaultdict(float)
cust_count = defaultdict(int)
for o in orders:
    c = o.get("Customer", "Unknown")
    cust_spend[c] += float(o.get("Total Paid", 0))
    cust_count[c] += 1
top_customers = sorted(cust_spend.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:5]

# Products
prod_count = defaultdict(int)
for o in orders:
    items = o.get("Items", "")
    for item in items.split(","):
        item = item.strip()
        if item:
            prod_count[item] += 1
top_products = sorted(prod_count.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:5]

# Date range
dates = sorted(set(o.get("Date", "") for o in orders))

# Build summary
lines = []
lines.append("ORDER DATA SUMMARY REPORT")
lines.append("=" * 40)
lines.append("")
lines.append(f"Date Range: {dates[0]} to {dates[-1]}")
lines.append(f"Total Orders: {total_orders}")
lines.append(f"  - Confirmed: {len(confirmed)}")
lines.append(f"  - Cancelled: {len(cancelled)}")
lines.append(f"Total Revenue (all orders): ${total_revenue:,.2f}")
lines.append(f"Confirmed Revenue: ${confirmed_revenue:,.2f}")
lines.append(f"Cancelled Revenue: ${cancelled_revenue:,.2f}")
lines.append(f"Average Order Value: ${avg_order:,.2f}")
lines.append("")
lines.append("TOP 5 CUSTOMERS BY SPENDING:")
for i, (cust, spend) in enumerate(top_customers, 1):

lines.append("")
lines.append("KEY INSIGHTS:")
lines.append(f"  - {len(cancelled)}/{total_orders} orders ({100*len(cancelled)/total_orders:.0f}%) were cancelled")
lines.append(f"  - {len(set(o.get('Customer','') for o in orders))} unique customers placed orders")

print(summary)
